name: Janet AI
long_description:
Janet AI lets anyone on your team spin up 24/7 agents that reliably handle workflows across your existing tool stack around the clock. No migrations, no code, no API keys, no technical lift.

Few clicks to authenticate your tools (Slack, Granola, Google Drive, Notion, X, Salesforce, Linear, etc.) → describe the workflow in plain English → done in under 5 minutes. Get started for free today at janet.ai!

Under the hood, Janet runs on custom orchestration and memory infrastructure we built for 24/7 agent operation. It does the job the same way every run, and it continuously builds a map of your company from everything it sees and your feedback, so it gets better every week.

Janet AI is backed by Y Combinator, Formosa Capital, Paul Graham, Charles Ferguson, and others.
one_liner: Agents that handle work 24/7 across the tools you already use
